title: Correction: the local models panel lasted two days
summary: A panel for local models merged on 21 November and was removed on 23 November. Our film Omarchy Everywhere, posted on the 24th, still described it.

topics.angle: AI that runs on your own computer.
Our correction: merged is not shipped.

claims.text: The panel for local models merged on 21 November and was removed on 23 November.
Coding models are now managed in the agents panel.
Image, video and music models belong to Fantasi and Flowtunes.
Our film Omarchy Everywhere, posted on 24 November, described the panel after it was gone.
Flowtunes generates music with ACE-Step 1.5 Turbo.
Of the 1,496 lines the panel’s change added outside tests, 278 were still in the code on 25 November, 19 percent.
Every change named in Peek Behind the Curtain had 71 percent or more of its lines left on 25 November.
Since 25 November, a program in omarchy-news reads every change a Peek Behind the Curtain film names again, at that day’s code, before the film is made.
